common: Production transparent 2D sprite sheet for the existing hand-drawn colored-pencil browser game. Use the attached shipped-roster contact sheet solely as an identity reference. Square canvas, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 complete separate sprites, equal cells, generous gutters, no grid, no scenery, no text. Same scale and anchor across poses; every full body fits inside its own cell. Rows 1-2: eight distinct chronological locomotion poses with visible alternating limbs and weight shifts, never eight copies of an idle pose. Row 3: four committed attack poses (anticipation, windup, impact, recovery). Row 4: four non-gory defeat poses (recoil, buckle, topple, fully collapsed or dissipated). Preserve thin black sketch outlines, hand-shaded pencil texture, recognizable shape and face.
